description: low woodland on deep sand, heath understorey
locality: Agnes Banks Woodland, western Sydney, New South Wales, Australia; study plants located near the reserve entry, bordered by road and walking tracks
disturbance: fire in October 1998 scorched all understorey vegetation prior to the 1999 flowering season studied
notes: Coordinates as stated in text (33°38'S, 150°41'E), converted from DMS. Fieldwork Feb-Jun 1999 and Jan-Apr 2000. Agnes Banks Woodland (covering ~half the reserve) was listed as an Endangered Ecological Community in 2000, with T. incisa as an identifying species.
